mapper.select: select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , '부산' as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '사용가능' and coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(cs.is_deleted, false) = false and ( cs.address like '부산%' or cs.address like '부산광역시%' or cs.address ilike '%Busan%' ) order by random() limit 1
mapper.update: update charger set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where charger_id = #{chargerId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fault_report where charger_id = #{chargerId} and status in ('접수', '점검중', '조치중', '결재대기')
mapper.insert: insert into fault_report ( station_id , charger_id , fault_type , title , description , severity , status , source_type , reported_at , created_at , updated_at ) select c.station_id , c.charger_id , #{faultType} , #{title} , #{description} , #{severity} , '접수' , #{sourceType} , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from charger c where c.charger_id = #{chargerId}
mapper.update: update charger set status = '사용가능', updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where status = '고장'
mapper.select: select count(*) from charger where status = '고장'

select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , case when cs.address like '부산%' then '부산' else split_part(cs.address, ' ', 1) end as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '고장' order by coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at) desc limit 5
mapper.insert: insert into app_member ( user_id , password , member_name , nickname , phone , email , user_type , login_type , status , created_at , updated_at ) select concat('stat_user_', lpad(gs::text, 3, '0')) , null , concat('통계회원', gs) , concat('통계회원', gs) , concat('010-77', lpad(gs::text, 2, '0'), '-', lpad(gs::text, 4, '0')) , concat('stat_user_', lpad(gs::text, 3, '0'), '@evcharge.test') , 'USER' , 'LOCAL' , 'ACTIVE' , current_timestamp - (gs || ' days')::interval , current_timestamp from generate_series(1, 30) gs on conflict (user_id) do nothing

with model_upsert as ( insert into vehicle_model ( manufacturer , model_name , battery_capacity_kwh , connector_type , max_charging_speed_kw , created_at , updated_at ) values ( '현대' , '아이오닉5' , 72.60 , 'DC콤보' , 200.00 , current_timestamp , current_timestamp ) on conflict (manufacturer, model_name) do nothing returning model_id ), model_pick as ( select model_id from model_upsert union all select model_id from vehicle_model where manufacturer = '현대' and model_name = '아이오닉5' limit 1 ) insert into vehicle ( member_id , model_id , vehicle_nickname , plate_number , is_default , created_at , updated_at ) select m.member_id , (select model_id from model_pick limit 1) , '통계 시연 차량' , concat('STAT', lpad(m.member_id::text, 4, '0')) , true , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from app_member m where m.user_id like 'stat_user_%' and not exists ( select 1 from vehicle v where v.member_id = m.member_id and coalesce(v.is_deleted, false) = false )

with seed as ( select gs.n , mv.member_id , mv.vehicle_id , ch.charger_id , ch.price_per_kwh , ch.charging_speed_kw , ( current_date - (floor(random() * #{days})::int) )::timestamp + ((floor(random() * 15) + 6)::int * interval '1 hour') + (floor(random() * 4)::int * interval '15 minutes') as start_time , (20 + floor(random() * 45))::int as current_soc , (70 + floor(random() * 25))::int as target_soc from generate_series(1, #{count}) gs(n) cross join lateral ( select m.member_id, v.vehicle_id from app_member m join vehicle v on m.member_id = v.member_id and coalesce(v.is_deleted, false) = false where m.status = 'ACTIVE' order by random() + gs.n * 0 limit 1 ) mv cross join lateral ( select c.charger_id, c.price_per_kwh, c.charging_speed_kw from charger c join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(st.is_deleted, false) = false and c.status in ('사용가능', '사용중', '예약중') order by random() + gs.n * 0 limit 1 ) ch ), calc as ( select n , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , price_per_kwh , charging_speed_kw , start_time , current_soc , target_soc , round((45 + random() * 28)::numeric, 2) as required_kwh , greatest(1, ceil((45 + random() * 28) / greatest(charging_speed_kw, 7) * 60))::int as estimated_minutes from seed where target_soc > current_soc ), inserted_reservation as ( insert into reservation ( member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , reservation_date , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , estimated_cost , status , auth_code , verified_at , created_at , updated_at ) select member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time::date , start_time , start_time + (estimated_minutes || ' minutes')::interval , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , round(required_kwh * price_per_kwh, 0) , '완료' , concat('STAT_', to_char(clock_timestamp(), 'HH24MISSMS'), '_', n) , start_time , start_time - interval '15 minutes' , current_timestamp from calc returning reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , estimated_cost ) insert into charging_session ( reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , actual_start_time , actual_end_time , start_soc , end_soc , actual_kwh , actual_minutes , actual_cost , status , created_at , updated_at ) select reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , greatest(1, estimated_minutes) , estimated_cost , '완료' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from inserted_reservation
mapper.select: select count(*) from charging_session where status = '완료'
